issue.title: Upd AS
issue.body:
# Creating the pull request

> Please include a summary of the change and which issue is fixed\
> If the related issue does not exist in our repository, please create it before making pull request\
> It is highly recommended to use our [Web Reporting Tool](https://kb.adguard.com/technical-support/reporting-tool) instead of creating an issue on GitHub directly\
> Please note, that we verify every pull request manually, so it may take time to apply it

## Prerequisites

### To avoid invalid pull requests, please check and confirm following terms

- [x] This is not an ad/bug report;
- [x] My code follows the [guidelines](https://github.com/AdguardTeam/AdguardFilters/blob/master/CONTRIBUTING.md) and [syntax](https://kb.adguard.com/general/how-to-create-your-own-ad-filters) of this project;
- [x] I have performed a self-review of my own changes;
- [x] My changes do not break web sites, apps and files structure.

## What problem does the pull request fix?

### If the problem does not fall under any category that is listed here, please write a comment below in corresponding section

- [x] Missed ads or ad leftovers;
- [ ] Website or app doesn't work properly;
- [ ] AdGuard gets detected on a website;
- [ ] Missed analytics or tracker;
- [ ] Social media buttons — share, like, tweet, etc;
- [ ] Annoyances — pop-ups, cookie warnings, etc;
- [x] Filters maintenance.

## What issue is being fixed?

### Enter the issue address

Fix #245499
Fix #245528
Fix #245624

Updated the regex patterns to match new AS URL's and added `index.hr`, `euronews.com`, `base64decode.org` & `addictinggames.com` to the rules.

Here are some example AS URL's
```
https://coil.ruleacidly.com/commons/0_qnj.js
https://coil.ruleacidly.com/ui2kit/xzCF_UOD4t.js
https://coil.ruleacidly.com/polyfills/RUTe-7.js
https://coil.injectoften.com/lib.core/OZv_Vmt.js
https://coil.ruleacidly.com/vendor2/1DF_pzwE.js
https://fun.whollyeven.com/pkg64/3k-7c.js
https://coil.injectoften.com/main9a/F2MB-I.js
https://coil.injectoften.com/assets/t-LiwNBOD.js
https://coil.injectoften.com/chunks/s-PV5i.js
https://coil.injectoften.com/main.v2/WJ_GVse.js
https://disk.robinorchid.com/rt_main/5ir-jU.js
```

Sites using these:
``
https://www.mavericktruckclub.com/
https://spanjevandaag.com/
https://www.index.hr/
https://windsorstar.com/
https://www.euronews.com/
https://deadline.com/
``

Note: EasyList has been doing a good job of blocking the domains, but unfortunately, the delay before the rules are added to AdGuard means they often aren’t blocked in time, since AS frequently changes domains.

### Terms

- [x] By submitting this issue, I agree that pull request does not contain private info and all conditions are met

comment.body: Hi, after internal discussion, in order for us to keep easier maintenance and consistency of the rules, we will only receive reports of Ad-Shield issues and will not review complicated PRs about them at the moment. We will restore the review process in the future.

comment.body:
Candidate rule proposed ## Reproduced symptom Reproduced — The Lancaser Archery product page shows a Klaviyo "Sign up for 10% off" flyout newsletter modal over the lower-right footer, which no existing Annoyances rule hides; a domain-scoped element-hiding rule for the Klaviyo flyout container was verified in the extension (modal visible before, hidden after, page integrity intact). ## Rule `lancasterarchery.com##div[aria-label="FLYOUT Form"]` ## Executor and version Pinned prebuilt release v5.5.2.3 ## Policy rationale The report is a newsletter/discount sign-up popup (annoyance) rendered by a Klaviyo onsite form, not the site's own advertising, not a paywall, and not an anti-adblock wall, so none of the policy's no-rule categories applies. The instruction's maintainer rule for popups applies:⁠ a cosmetic rule that hides the popup is fine when the page then works — the content stays accessible, the page scrolls, and the popup did not reappear in the validated phase. ## Place in the list [AnnoyancesFilter/Popups/sections/subscriptions_specific.txt](https://github.com/AdguardTeam/AdguardFilters/blob/e26a24523c09f490a838d1d324ceb0f7637a532a/AnnoyancesFilter/Popups/sections/subscriptions_specific.txt) At the end of the file. ## Screenshots
Without and with the rule | Without the rule | With the rule | |---|---| | | |
## Artifacts https://github.com/AdguardTeam/AdguardFilters/actions/runs/40984694180 Automated analysis against filters at `e26a245`. Posted by a filters agent; a maintainer reviews before anything is merged.
